ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. That the Chicago Zoning Ordinance be amended by changing RT-4
Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as shown on
Map 1-I in the area bounded by:

West Maypole Avenue; a line 392.1 feet west of and parallel to North Talman

Avenue; a line 110 feet south of and parallel to West Maypole Avenue; a line

376.1 feet west of and parallel to North Talman Avenue; West Washington

Boulevard; and a line 530.36 feet west of and parallel to North Talman Avenue.
to those of the B1-2 Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Address: 2678 West Washington Boulevard
